common_name: Angel Eyes Hardy Hibiscus (White Raspberry-Eyed Early-Blooming Perennial Hibiscus, Proven Selections)

planting.note: Plant container plants or divisions in spring in consistently moist, fertile soil in full sun.

directions: A Proven Selections hardy hibiscus noted as one of the earliest Summerific-type rose mallows to flower each season, opening huge white blooms with a bold raspberry-red eye that radiates out through each petal. Plants build a broad, upright mound of green foliage reaching about 5 feet tall and wide, growing quickly once they emerge later than most spring perennials. Grow in full sun with average, consistent moisture; the plants are heat tolerant, deer resistant, and draw bees and hummingbirds from midsummer through early fall.
sources: Proven Winners — Proven Selections Angel Eyes Hibiscus product page

common_name: Blackberry Merlot Hardy Hibiscus (Deep Velvety Red Perennial Hibiscus, Proven Selections)

planting.note: Plant container plants or divisions in spring in consistently moist, fertile soil in full sun.

directions: This online-exclusive Proven Selections introduction carries 8-inch, richly saturated deep red flowers over tight, upright deep green foliage, giving it a tidier profile than many Summerific-type hardy hibiscus. Mature clumps reach 4 to 4.5 feet tall and 3.5 to 4 feet wide, making it useful as a thriller plant in large containers as well as borders. Plant in full sun with average, consistent moisture; it is heat tolerant and deer resistant, blooming from midsummer into early fall and drawing bees and butterflies.
sources: Proven Winners — Proven Selections Blackberry Merlot Hibiscus product page

common_name: Marshmallow Moon Hardy Hibiscus (Pure White Large-Flowered Perennial Hibiscus, Proven Selections)

planting.note: Plant container plants or divisions in spring in consistently moist, fertile soil in full sun.

directions: A Proven Selections hardy hibiscus grown for enormous, thick-petaled pure white blooms measuring 6 to 6.5 inches across, held well above a broad mound of green foliage. The wide, spreading habit tops out at just 3 to 3.5 feet tall but can reach about 4 feet across, so give it room on either side. Plant in full sun with average, consistently moist soil; like other hardy hibiscus it emerges late in spring but grows rapidly, flowering from midsummer through early fall and attracting bees and hummingbirds while resisting deer.
sources: Proven Winners — Proven Selections Marshmallow Moon Hibiscus product page

common_name: Summer in Paradise Hardy Hibiscus (Hot Cerise-Red Maple-Leaved Perennial Hibiscus, Proven Selections)

planting.note: Plant container plants or divisions in spring in consistently moist, well-drained soil; tolerates part sun to full sun.

directions: This Proven Selections rose mallow produces jaw-dropping, hot cerise-red blooms 7 to 8 inches across over medium green, maple-like leaves edged in olive. The refined, upright habit stays compact at 3 to 3.5 feet tall and 3.5 to 4 feet wide, needing little maintenance once established. It tolerates part sun to full sun in moist, well-drained soil of varying fertility, flowering from midsummer through early fall and attracting butterflies while resisting deer.
sources: Proven Winners — Proven Selections Summer in Paradise Hibiscus product page
